rationale: A shared seat can host multiple concurrent sessions, so 'this seat is claimed' is not by itself proof that THIS worker's own session is the one being displaced. Standing down on an unverified seat-level claim can wrongly abandon live, legitimate work. Ignoring the claim unconditionally is also wrong: if the claim DOES name this worker's own session, standing down is correct -- the verification step, not either extreme, is the lawful action.
